retainedReference.title: Tretyakov Gallery, historic Lavrushinsky Lane complex

pictures.author: A.Savin
pictures.observed: Actually viewed1280px whole-front photo: orange-red main wall, long cream inscription panels, dark colored frieze, raised gray keeled facade with arched lights/relief, three cream entry gables, rounded central doorway and glazed gallery roof lanterns. Monument/furniture and inscriptions are omitted.

pictures.author: Sergey A. Demidov
pictures.observed: Actually viewed1280px oblique entrance view: layered scalloped/stepped gables and gold-colored edging, gray vertical window/relief feature, cream frieze bands, pale framed hipped glazed left roof, two triangular glazed ridges behind the facade. Fence/temporary ramps are context, not reconstructed.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Historic Lavrushinsky Lane Tretyakov Gallery and contiguous northern gallery range: original connected map footprint, orange-red rendered walls, cream inscription panels without copied text, dark patterned frieze, raised gray keeled central facade with arched lights/abstract relief, three scalloped entrance gables and a genuine recessed central arched doorway, and repeated framed glazed roof lanterns. Exterior only. Preserve the independent engineering building, church, modern detached gallery and neighbors. No furnished galleries, paintings, statue likeness, copied signs, lettering or heraldic artwork.
